_source: The example response of the Automation API reference, appbundles-id-GET (developer.doc.autodesk.com/bPlouYTd/design-automation-forge-doc-master-792222/design-automation/v3/reference/http/design-automation/appbundles-id-GET.html), read 2026-11-01: the package link, the fully qualified id, the engine and the version (the reference's body structure adds description).
